items.name: The Academy Graduate
items.summary: You represent the elite tier of institutional training.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Leadership-Command] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#command" >}})
[Tactics-Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}})
[Administration-Management] ({{< relref "/skills/administration/#management" >}})
[Culture-Etiquette] ({{< relref "/skills/culture/#etiquette-specific" >}})
items.equipment: A pristine dress uniform, a standard-issue officer's sidearm, a tactical holomap projector, and a low-level clearance badge.
items.special_ability: **Tactical Evaluation:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Awareness-Perception] ({{< relref "/skills/awareness/#perception" >}}) or [Tactics-Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}}) checks made specifically to evaluate an opponent's combat formation, defensive weaknesses, or equipment quality before an engagement begins.
items.tendencies:
**The Officer in Charge:** Assert your rank or authority to take command of a chaotic situation, even when doing so makes you the primary target for enemies or social scrutiny.
**The Strategist:** Refuse to deviate from a sophisticated or "correct" tactical plan even when a simpler, more "rugged" solution is available, prioritizing the doctrine you were taught.

items.name: Austin Combat School Graduate
items.summary: A graduate of a premier military academy known for producing disciplined and tactically brilliant soldiers.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Leadership-Command] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#command" >}})
[Armor Operation] ({{< relref "/skills/armor-operation/" >}})
[Heavy Weapons-Direct Fire] ({{< relref "/skills/heavy-weapons/#direct-fire" >}})
[Resolve-Mental Resolve] ({{< relref "/skills/resolve/#mental-resolve" >}})
items.equipment: A dress uniform, a graduation ring or medal.
items.special_ability: **Academy Discipline:** Receive a -1 step bonus to all [Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/" >}}) or [Leadership] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/" >}}) checks after assessing the situation for one round.

items.name: The Bounty Hunter
items.summary: The galaxy is vast, but for you, it is just a series of footprints and digital trails.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Investigate-Track] ({{< relref "/skills/investigate/#track" >}})
[Law-Law Enforcement Procedures] ({{< relref "/skills/law/#law-enforcement-procedures" >}})
[Awareness-Perception] ({{< relref "/skills/awareness/#perception" >}})
[Street Smart-Street Knowledge] ({{< relref "/skills/street-smart/#street-knowledge" >}})
items.flaw: [Powerful Enemy] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#powerful-enemy" >}}) (Someone you caught, or someone you’re currently hunting who has the upper hand).
items.equipment: An armored longcoat, two sets of heavy-duty binders, a tracking fob/scanner, and a heavy pistol or stun baton.
items.special_ability: **Skip Tracer:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Investigate-Search] ({{< relref "/skills/investigate/#search" >}}) checks when looking for information regarding a specific individual's current location or recent history.
items.tendencies:
**The Single-Minded:** Pursue a target or a lead into a clearly dangerous or disadvantageous situation instead of choosing a safer, slower path.
**The Professional:** Honor the specific letter of a contract even when offered a more profitable "side deal" or an easier moral out.

items.name: The Breacher
items.summary: Specialist in bypassing physical barriers and initiating tactical entries.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Security-Security Devices] ({{< relref "/skills/security/#security-devices" >}})
[Tactics-Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}})
[Modern Ranged Weapons] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/" >}})
[Athletics-Climb] ({{< relref "/skills/athletics/#climb" >}})
items.equipment: Entry kit, breaching charge, tactical shotgun.
items.special_ability: **Tactical Entry:** -1 step bonus to [Security] ({{< relref "/skills/security/" >}}) or [Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/" >}}) when initiating combat or bypassing barriers.

items.name: The Certified Psychic
items.summary: You are an autonomous legal entity, granted the rare authority to use psionic powers openly.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Telepathy-Mind Reading] ({{< relref "/psionics/telepathy/#mind-reading" >}})
[Law-Court Procedures] ({{< relref "/skills/law/#court-procedures" >}})
[Interaction-Interview] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#interview" >}})
[Resolve-Mental Resolve] ({{< relref "/skills/resolve/#mental-resolve" >}})
items.flaw: [Code of Honor] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor" >}}) (Absolute neutrality and adherence to the strict ethical guidelines of your autonomous certification).
items.equipment: An official arbiter's badge/warrant, a portable recording device, formal professional wear, and mild sedatives/stimulants for psychic strain.
items.special_ability: **Autonomous Arbiter:** Your psionic verification is legally binding. You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/" >}}) or [Law] ({{< relref "/skills/law/" >}}) checks when acting as a neutral third party in negotiations or when asserting your legal right to verify the truth of a statement in the field.
items.tendencies:
**The Absolute Truth:** Force a harsh or dangerous truth out into the open to maintain your absolute neutrality, even when a polite lie or deception would have made things easier for the party.
**The Unwanted Judge:** Complicate a situation by acting on a crime or dark secret you gleaned from someone's mind, using your autonomous authority to intervene when it wasn't your fight.

items.name: The Corporate Enforcer
items.summary: Muscle for megacorporations, specializing in asset protection and dispute resolution.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Security-Protection Protocols] ({{< relref "/skills/security/#protection-protocols" >}})
[Law-Law Enforcement Procedures] ({{< relref "/skills/law/#law-enforcement-procedures" >}})
[Interaction- Intimidate] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#intimidate" >}})
[Modern Ranged Weapons-Pistol] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/#pistol" >}})
items.equipment: Armored business suit, high-caliber sidearm.
items.special_ability: **Asset Protection:** -1 step bonus to [Interaction-Intimidate] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#intimidate" >}}) or [Security] ({{< relref "/skills/security/" >}}) when protecting assets.

items.name: The Criminal / Urchin
items.summary: Life on the streets taught you how to survive, but it left you with a name that the authorities won't forget.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Street Smart-Street Knowledge] ({{< relref "/skills/street-smart/#street-knowledge" >}})
[Covert Ops-Pickpocket] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#pickpocket" >}})
[Covert Ops-Stealth] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#stealth" >}})
[Deception-Bribe] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bribe" >}})
[Security- Security Devices] ({{< relref "/skills/security/#security-devices" >}})
items.equipment: A well-used physical or electronic entry kit, a burner comm-link, a forged low-tier ID, and a reliable street-made weapon (like a shiv or a holdout pistol).
items.special_ability: None. (Your raw survival instincts are instead reflected mechanically by receiving a free broad skill to represent your foundational street upbringing).
items.tendencies:
**The Opportunist:** Take an unnecessary risk to secure a personal profit or an "angle."
**The Paranoiac:** Compromise a plan to ensure you have a clear escape route.

items.name: The Deserter
items.summary: You are a ghost in the machine.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Survival-Survival Training] ({{< relref "/skills/survival/#survival-training" >}})
[Deception-Bluff] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bluff" >}})
[Covert Ops-Conceal] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#conceal" >}})
items.equipment: A military-grade weapon (with filed-off serial numbers), a rugged survival tent or sleeping roll, and a high-quality fake ident-card.
items.special_ability: **Safehouse Intuition:** You have a -1 step bonus to find makeshift shelter, black-market supplies, or sympathetic contacts in hostile territory.
items.tendencies:
**The Pragmatic Escape:** Abandon a cause when the risks become "unacceptable" to ensure your survival.
**The Hidden Hand:** Pass up fame or reward to ensure your identity remains undiscovered.

items.name: The Diplomat
items.summary: You were raised in the halls of power, where protocol is a weapon and reputation is everything.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Culture-Etiquette] ({{< relref "/skills/culture/#etiquette-specific" >}})
[Administration-Bureaucracy] ({{< relref "/skills/administration/#bureaucracy" >}})
[Interaction-Charm] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#charm" >}})
[Interaction-Bargain] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#bargain" >}})
items.equipment: A tailored high-society suit, an encrypted datapad with a localized legal codex, and a ceremonial or easily concealable sidearm.
items.special_ability: **Diplomatic Immunity:** In settled systems, you are often exempt from minor local laws and routine searches while on official business. This immunity extends strictly to your person and your personal cabin aboard a vessel, unless the ship itself is registered as a diplomatic transport. You receive a -1 step bonus to checks involving legal navigation.
items.tendencies:
**The Mediator:** Attempt to resolve a hostile situation through negotiation even when combat is easier.
**The Architect:** Delay action to ensure every social variable or consequence is accounted for.

items.name: The Face
items.summary: You are a master of the "hustle.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Entertainment-Act] ({{< relref "/skills/entertainment/#act" >}})
[Deception-Bluff] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bluff" >}})
[Interaction-Bargain] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#bargain" >}})
[Interaction-Charm] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#charm" >}})
items.flaw: [Obsessed] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#obsessed" >}}) (With maintaining your public image, luxury standards, or personal vanity).
items.equipment: An extravagant wardrobe suitable for high-end venues, a cosmetic disguise kit, and a flashy but low-caliber sidearm.
items.special_ability: **The Scrounger:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Interaction-Bargain] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#bargain" >}}) or [Street Smart-Street Knowledge] ({{< relref "/skills/street-smart/#street-knowledge" >}}) checks when trying to acquire specific equipment or restricted items through non- monetary means (cons, favors, or "borrowing").
items.tendencies:
**The Spotlight Seeker:** Intentionally draw attention to yourself in a social setting to create a distraction, even when being inconspicuous is safer.
**The Hustler:** Attempt to "scam" or talk your way out of a problem or into a restricted area using your personal appeal, even when a more direct (but less elegant) method exists.

[Medical Science-Treatment] ({{< relref "/skills/medical-science/#treatment" >}})

[Resolve- Physical Resolve] ({{< relref "/skills/resolve/#physical-resolve" >}})
items.flaw: [Code of Honor] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor" >}}) (Medic Oath) or [Old Injury] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#old-injury" >}})
items.equipment: Trauma kit, surgical laser, advanced bandages.
items.special_ability: **Under Fire:** -1 step bonus to medical checks during combat or under threat.

[Knowledge-Deduce] ({{< relref "/skills/knowledge/#deduce" >}})
[Investigate-Search] ({{< relref "/skills/investigate/#search" >}})

[Awareness- Perception] ({{< relref "/skills/awareness/#perception" >}})
items.equipment: Field scanner, sampling kits, environmental suit.
items.special_ability: **Rapid Analysis:** -1 step bonus to [Knowledge-Deduce] ({{< relref "/skills/knowledge/#deduce" >}}) or [Investigate-Search] ({{< relref "/skills/investigate/#search" >}}) in the field.

items.tendencies:
**The Negotiator:** Solve a conflict by brokering a deal that moves the plot forward.
**The Asset Manager:** Risk an objective to preserve a useful contact or piece of equipment.

[Navigation-Astrogation System] ({{< relref "/skills/navigation/#astrogation-system" >}})
[System Operation-Sensors] ({{< relref "/skills/system-operation/#sensors" >}})
[Leadership-Command] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#command" >}})
items.flaw: [Code of Honor] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor" >}}) (Strict adherence to naval protocol and superiority).

items.special_ability: **Bridge Intuition:** You have a -1 step bonus to all [System Operation] ({{< relref "/skills/system-operation/" >}}) specialty skill checks while on the bridge of a starship, representing your deep familiarity with fleet-standard interfaces and emergency protocols.
items.tendencies:
**The Ship’s Soul:** Prioritize the structural integrity and long-term maintenance of the vessel over personal equipment or mission objectives.
**The Protocol Purist:** Insist on following standard naval communications and engagement protocols even when operating in the "wild" or with civilian crews, potentially causing social friction.

items.name: The Freelance Captain

items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Vehicle Operation-Space Vehicle] ({{< relref "/skills/vehicle-operation/#space-vehicle" >}})
[Navigation-Astrogation System] ({{< relref "/skills/navigation/#astrogation-system" >}})
[Business-Small Business] ({{< relref "/skills/business/#small-business" >}})
[Leadership-Command] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#command" >}})
items.equipment: Pilot's coat, navigational computer, sidearm.
items.special_ability: **Born for the Void:** -1 step bonus to pilot or astrogation checks aboard own vessel.

[Covert Ops-Conceal] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#conceal" >}})
[Deception-Bluff] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bluff" >}})

items.special_ability: **Zero Footprint:** -1 step bonus to [Stealth] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/" >}}) or [Deception] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/" >}}) when infiltrating.

[Deception-Bluff] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bluff" >}})
[Interaction-Charm] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#charm" >}})
[Manipulation-Pickpocket] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#pickpocket" >}})
[Deception-Bribe] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bribe" >}})
items.equipment: Designer clothes, forged IDs, fixer's kit.
items.special_ability: **The Long Con:** -1 step bonus to social manipulation lasting over 24 hours.

[Business-Illicit Business] ({{< relref "/skills/business/#illicit-business" >}})
[Street Smart-Criminal Elements] ({{< relref "/skills/street-smart/#criminal-elements" >}})
[Covert Ops-Conceal] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#conceal" >}})
[Modern Ranged Weapons-Pistol] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/#pistol" >}})
items.flaw: [Obsessed] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#obsessed" >}}) (With digital security and uncovering conspiracies, making you overly cautious and prone to distrusting physical allies).
items.equipment: A high-end custom cyberdeck or illegal intrusion rig, a biometric spoofer, an encrypted burner drive, and a mild stimulant supply.
items.special_ability: **Backdoor Access:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Computer Science-Hacking] ({{< relref "/skills/computer-science/#hacking" >}}) or [Security-Security Devices] ({{< relref "/skills/security/#security-devices" >}}) checks when attempting to bypass digital security, decrypt files, or spoof electronic access logs.
items.tendencies:
**The Digital Ghost:** Prioritize erasing your digital footprint or stealing secondary data over the physical safety or immediate tactical needs of the party.
**The Curious Intruder:** Cannot resist poking into a secure system or locked file even when it has nothing to do with the current mission and risks triggering alarms.

items.name: The Innovator

[Technical Science-Invention] ({{< relref "/skills/technical-science/#invention" >}})
[Technical Science-Juryrig] ({{< relref "/skills/technical-science/#juryrig" >}})
[Computer Science-Hardware] ({{< relref "/skills/computer-science/#hardware" >}})
[Technical Science-Repair] ({{< relref "/skills/technical-science/#repair" >}})
items.equipment: Multi-tool kit, diagnostic screen, salvage parts.
items.special_ability: **MacGyver Instinct:** Create temporary tools or fixes with -2 step bonus once per session.

[Modern Ranged Weapons] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/" >}})

items.flaw: [Code of Honor] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor" >}}) or [Old Injury] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#old-injury" >}})
items.equipment: A reliable weapon, a set of dog tags.
items.special_ability: **Soldier of Fortune:** Receive a -1 step bonus to [Survival] ({{< relref "/skills/survival/" >}}) or [Awareness- Intuition] ({{< relref "/skills/awareness/#intuition" >}}) when identifying ambushes or hostile intent.

items.name: The Military Brat

[Tactics-Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}})
[Resolve-Physical Resolve] ({{< relref "/skills/resolve/#physical-resolve" >}})
[Knowledge-First Aid] ({{< relref "/skills/knowledge/#first-aid" >}})
items.equipment: A piece of surplus military gear (like a rugged fatigue jacket or combat boots), a basic field medkit, and a standard-issue sidearm.

items.tendencies:
**The Order-Follower:** Adhere to a plan or instruction even when circumstances have shifted.
**The Protector:** Put yourself at risk to cover an ally's flank.

items.name: The Operative
items.summary: Paramilitary professional specialized in direct action and tactical missions.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Modern Ranged Weapons-SMG] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/#smg" >}})
[Stamina-Endurance] ({{< relref "/skills/stamina/#endurance" >}})
[Tactics- Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}})
[Athletics-Run] ({{< relref "/skills/athletics/#run" >}})
items.equipment: SMG, tactical fatigues, comm-link.

[Telepathy-Contact] ({{< relref "/psionics/telepathy/#contact" >}})
[ESP- Empathy] ({{< relref "/psionics/esp/#empathy" >}})

items.equipment: Simple clergy robes, a holy symbol or meditative focus.
items.special_ability: **Psy-Focus:** Receive a -1 step bonus to all [Resolve] ({{< relref "/skills/resolve/" >}}) checks when resisting non-psionic mental stress or fatigue.

[Survival-Survival Training] ({{< relref "/skills/survival/#survival-training" >}})
[Athletics-Climb] ({{< relref "/skills/athletics/#climb" >}})
[Athletics- Throw] ({{< relref "/skills/athletics/#throw" >}})
[Awareness-Perception] ({{< relref "/skills/awareness/#perception" >}})
[Covert Ops-Stealth] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#stealth" >}})
items.equipment: A sturdy archaic weapon (like a spear, bow, or heavy blade), a survival knife, tribal or clan tokens, and rugged survival clothing.
items.special_ability: None. (Your survival is bought with a wide array of raw, physical skills).
items.tendencies:
**The Traditionalist:** Solve a modern problem using an ancient, low-tech, or ritualistic method.
**The Loner:** Take a disadvantage to handle a task entirely on your own, refusing the help of "soft" technology or teammates.

items.name: The Paramilitary Officer
items.summary: You didn't train at a prestigious academy or fight under a planetary flag.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Leadership-Command] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#command" >}})
[Tactics-Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}})
[Business-Small Business] ({{< relref "/skills/business/#small-business" >}})
[Modern Ranged Weapons-Assault Rifle] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/#rifle" >}})
items.flaw: [Code of Honor] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#code-of-honor" >}}) (The Mercenary's Code: You never break a signed contract, you never betray a client who has paid in full, and you expect subordinates to follow your orders without question).

items.special_ability: **Asymmetrical Warfare:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Tactics-Infantry Tactics] ({{< relref "/skills/tactics/#infantry-tactics" >}}) or [Survival-Survival Training] ({{< relref "/skills/survival/#survival-training" >}}) checks when executing an ambush, fighting a guerrilla campaign, or operating entirely cut off from official supply lines.
items.tendencies:
**The Mercenary:** Demand renegotiation, hazard pay, or a clear tactical advantage before committing to a dangerous firefight that wasn't in the original plan.
**The Pragmatist:** Disregard traditional rules of engagement or "honorable" doctrine in favor of traps, sabotage, or overwhelming disproportionate force.

[Interaction-Interview] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#interview" >}})

[Demolitions-Set Explosives] ({{< relref "/skills/demolitions/#set-explosives" >}})
[Heavy Weapons-Direct Fire] ({{< relref "/skills/heavy-weapons/#direct-fire" >}})
[Technical Science-Juryrig] ({{< relref "/skills/technical-science/#juryrig" >}})
[Modern Ranged Weapons] ({{< relref "/skills/modern-ranged-weapons/" >}})
items.equipment: Explosive blocks, detonator, tactical jacket.
items.special_ability: **Demolitions Expert:** -1 step bonus to explosives or jury-rig checks to destroy structures.

items.summary: Fringe survivor finding and fixing value in planetary junk and derelicts.

items.name: The Ship Owner
items.summary: You hold the keys to the most valuable asset in the galaxy: a starship.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Vehicle Operation-Space Vehicle] ({{< relref "/skills/vehicle-operation/#space-vehicle" >}})
[Business-Small Business] ({{< relref "/skills/business/#small-business" >}})
[Leadership-Command] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#command" >}})
[Administration-Management] ({{< relref "/skills/administration/#management" >}})
items.flaw: [Debt Ridden] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#debt-ridden" >}}) (You owe a massive debt on your vessel. Unlike other flaws, this cannot be bought off with XP during character advancement; it can only be removed by physically paying off the creditor in-game. Furthermore, if you miss a payment, the creditor can make demands, forcing you to take dangerous jobs or favor their interests to keep the ship).
items.equipment: A captain's coat, a heavy spanner or multi- tool, and a personal distress beacon linked to your ship.
items.special_ability: **Captain and Commander:** You begin the game in possession of a starship capable of interstellar travel and accommodating the entire party.
items.tendencies:
**The Bottom Line:** Make a tactical or narrative decision strictly based on financial gain or the physical preservation of your ship, ignoring moral pleas or personal risks.
**My Ship, My Rules:** Assert your absolute authority over a situation or passenger while aboard your vessel, even when deferring to an ally or expert would be significantly safer.

items.name: The Smuggler
items.summary: You make your living in the gray areas between borders and laws.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Business-Illicit Business] ({{< relref "/skills/business/#illicit-business" >}})
[Covert Ops-Conceal] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#conceal" >}})
[Deception-Bribe] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bribe" >}})
[Street Smart-Criminal Elements] ({{< relref "/skills/street-smart/#criminal-elements" >}})
items.flaw: [Powerful Enemy] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#powerful-enemy" >}}) (A relentless customs inspector or a syndicate boss you double-crossed).
items.equipment: An oversized coat with hidden sensor-baffled pockets, a holdout blaster, a physical ledger, and a set of fake transponder codes or IDs.
items.special_ability: **Smuggler's Hold:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Covert Ops-Conceal] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#conceal" >}}) checks when hiding objects, data, or people from physical inspections or routine sensor sweeps.
items.tendencies:
**The Contrabandist:** Take a narrative or tactical risk to sneak something illegal or restricted into a secure area, even if the current mission doesn't strictly require it.
**The Burner:** Dump valuable cargo, abandon a lucrative deal, or cut ties with a useful contact at the first sign of official scrutiny to ensure your own freedom.

items.name: The Subverter
items.summary: You use your art not for the galleries, but for the streets.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Creativity-Specific Skill] ({{< relref "/skills/creativity/#creativity-specific-skill" >}}) (e.g., holo art, public graffiti, or propaganda design)
[Deception-Bluff] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bluff" >}})
[Covert Ops-Stealth] ({{< relref "/skills/covert-ops/#stealth" >}})
[Leadership-Inspire] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#inspire" >}})
items.favored_perks: [Powerful Ally] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#powerful-ally" >}}) (An underground resistance movement, anarchist collective, or decentralized hacker group).
items.flaw: [Infamy] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#infamy" >}}) (Known to local authorities or megacorporations as a dangerous vandal and agitator).
items.equipment: A portable signal-hijacker or high-yield spray tech, an encrypted data-drive full of propaganda, a breather mask to obscure your face, and rugged street clothes.
items.special_ability: **Subliminal Messaging:** You have a -1 step bonus to [Leadership-Inspire] ({{< relref "/skills/leadership/#inspire" >}}) or [Deception-Bluff] ({{< relref "/skills/deception/#bluff" >}}) checks when you use your art to incite a crowd, cause a public distraction, or rapidly sway public opinion.
items.tendencies:
**The Calling Card:** Leave a recognizable piece of your art or propaganda at the scene of a mission, intentionally drawing attention to yourself and risking immediate discovery.
**The Agitator:** Openly provoke authority figures or corporate security, using the resulting chaos to make a political point even if it jeopardizes the current operation.

**Hyper-Awareness:** -1 step bonus to physical resolve or
intuition when resisting toxins or threats.

items.name: The Virtuoso
items.summary: You are a master of aesthetics and performance.
items.favored_specialty_skills:
[Creativity-Artistic Expression] ({{< relref "/skills/creativity/#artistic-expression" >}})
[Culture-Etiquette] ({{< relref "/skills/culture/#etiquette-specific" >}})
[Entertainment-Act] ({{< relref "/skills/entertainment/#act" >}})
[Interaction-Charm] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#charm" >}})
items.flaw: [Temper] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#temper" >}}) (A volatile artistic ego that flares up unpredictably when your work, vision, or status is criticized or interrupted).
items.equipment: High-end, custom-made creation tools (a bespoke holo-stylus or physical mediums), luxury attire, and a portable digital portfolio.
items.special_ability: **Patron's Favor & Catharsis:** You can leverage your artistic prestige to gain access to exclusive events or secure funding. You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction- Charm] ({{< relref "/skills/interaction/#charm" >}}) or [Culture-Etiquette] ({{< relref "/skills/culture/#etiquette-specific" >}}) checks when dealing with high-society patrons or art enthusiasts (this bonus improves to -2 steps if you possess the [Filthy Rich] ({{< relref "/perks_flaws/#filthy-rich" >}}) perk). Additionally, engaging in your art provides psychological relief: if using the Persistent Stress optional rules, a successful [Creativity-Artistic Expression] ({{< relref "/skills/creativity/#artistic-expression" >}}) check grants a +1 (Ordinary), +2 (Good), or +3 (Amazing) step bonus to Personality feats made to resist stress penalties.
items.tendencies:
**The Aesthete:** Choose a course of action based purely on its aesthetic appeal or dramatic flair rather than its tactical soundness or efficiency.
**The Diva:** Refuse to cooperate or compromise with the party until your specific, often petty, demands regarding comfort or artistic integrity are met.

items.name: The Wage Slave
items.summary: Bureaucratic survivor who knows how to navigate the complex red tape of the economy.

[Administration-Bureaucracy] ({{< relref "/skills/administration/#bureaucracy" >}})
[Knowledge-Computer Operation] ({{< relref "/skills/knowledge/#computer-operation" >}})
[Business-Corporate] ({{< relref "/skills/business/#corporate" >}})
[Administration-Management] ({{< relref "/skills/administration/#management" >}})
items.equipment: Business suit, corporate datapad, forms/templates.
items.special_ability: **Corporate Survival:** -1 step bonus to bureaucracy or business checks in large organizations.

items.flaw:

physical reminder of the event that made you famous).
items.equipment:
A personalized or heavily battle-scarred signature weapon, official
combat medals, a rugged military jacket, and a supply of medical
painkillers.
items.special_ability:
**Burden of Glory:** You receive a -1 step bonus to [Interaction]
({{< relref "/skills/interaction/" >}}) or [Leadership]
({{< relref "/skills/leadership/" >}}) skill checks when dealing
with veterans, active military personnel, or patriotic citizens who
recognize your service.
items.tendencies:
**The Living Legend:** Voluntarily accept a significant disadvantage or take the brunt of an attack to protect civilians or allies, driven by the need to live up to your impossible reputation.
**The Ghost of the Past:** React to a current situation using the outdated or traumatic context of your past war, complicating a simple negotiation or infiltration by treating it like a battlefield.

**The Hard Question:** Aggressively interrogate or provoke a powerful individual in a social setting, destroying diplomatic progress in order to gauge their reaction.
